## Scope

This pass freezes the minimum typed F4 relation/predicate vocabulary supported by repository evidence.

Relations represent evaluable semantic facts only.

They do not themselves authorize execution, transition state, establish admissibility, discharge invariants, or constitute proof results.

## Frozen relation boundaries

- RepresentsFinancialState != underlying financial-state truth
- RecordCommitted != financial finality
- RepresentsFinality != finality itself
- HistoricalRecordExists != current operability
- RecordReopenable != reopening occurrence
- LedgerContradictionExists != contradiction resolution
- RecordReconstructed != historical identity preservation
- RepresentsCustody != custody authority
- RecordContinuityClassified != continuity preservation
- RecordStateMatchesUnderlyingState != authority
- RecordAuthoritySupported != authority creation

## Core inherited distinction

final financial state != ledger representation of final financial state

- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-CON_INVARIANTS.md:17 | term=continuity | ## FIN-CON-001 — Continuity Is Independently Classified
- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-CON_INVARIANTS.md:19 | term=continuity | **Normative rule:** Financial continuity SHALL be classified independently from execution completion settlement finality and current balance.
- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-CON_INVARIANTS.md:21 | term=continuity | **Applies to:** Continuity
- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-CON_INVARIANTS.md:31 | term=continuity | ## FIN-CON-002 — Reconstruction Does Not Restore Continuity
- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-CON_INVARIANTS.md:33 | term=continuity | **Normative rule:** RECONSTRUCTED SHALL NOT imply PRESERVED continuity.
- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-CON_INVARIANTS.md:35 | term=continuity | **Applies to:** Continuity
- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-CON_INVARIANTS.md:45 | term=continuity | ## FIN-CON-003 — Restored Function Does Not Restore Continuity
- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-CON_INVARIANTS.md:47 | term=continuity | **Normative rule:** FUNCTIONALLY_RESTORED SHALL NOT imply PRESERVED continuity.
- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-CON_INVARIANTS.md:59 | term=continuity | ## FIN-CON-004 — Continuity Break Survives Later Equivalence
- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-CON_INVARIANTS.md:61 | term=continuity | **Normative rule:** A demonstrated continuity break SHALL remain historically true even if later state becomes economically equivalent.
- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-CON_INVARIANTS.md:63 | term=continuity | **Applies to:** Continuity history
- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-CON_INVARIANTS.md:73 | term=continuity | ## FIN-CON-005 — Indeterminate Continuity Is Not Preserved Continuity
- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-CON_INVARIANTS.md:75 | term=continuity | **Normative rule:** Insufficient continuity evidence SHALL result in INDETERMINATE rather than PRESERVED classification.
- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-CON_INVARIANTS.md:77 | term=continuity | **Applies to:** Continuity
- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-DST_INVARIANTS.md:75 | term=continuity | **Normative rule:** Consensus finality or replicated finality SHALL NOT erase evidence of prior authority admission or continuity failure.
- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-EVD_INVARIANTS.md:75 | term=continuity | **Normative rule:** Finality continuity and reconstruction classifications SHALL reference sufficient evidence.
- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-EXE_INVARIANTS.md:61 | term=continuity | **Normative rule:** COMPLETED SHALL NOT imply FINAL settlement state or preserved continuity.
- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-FIN_INVARIANTS.md:5 | term=continuity | Separate settlement finality from authorization, legitimacy, continuity, and historical integrity.
- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-FIN_INVARIANTS.md:59 | term=continuity | ## FIN-FIN-004 — Finality Does Not Establish Continuity
- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-FIN_INVARIANTS.md:61 | term=continuity | **Normative rule:** FINAL classification SHALL NOT imply PRESERVED continuity.
- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-REC_INVARIANTS.md:17 | term=continuity | ## FIN-REC-001 — Reconciliation Is Not Continuity
- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-REC_INVARIANTS.md:19 | term=continuity | **Normative rule:** RECONCILED SHALL NOT imply continuity was preserved.
- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-REC_INVARIANTS.md:33 | term=continuity | **Normative rule:** Reconstructed historical state SHALL NOT be classified as restored continuity merely because historical state can be reconstructed.
- F4-R-011 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-REC_INVARIANTS.md:75 | term=continuity | **Normative rule:** Where required historical evidence is insufficient the architecture SHALL classify reconstruction or continuity as indeterminate rather than restored.

- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-AGT_INVARIANTS.md:17 | term=authority | ## FIN-AGT-001 — Agent Capability Is Not Economic Authority
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-AGT_INVARIANTS.md:19 | term=authority | **Normative rule:** An autonomous agent's ability to construct sign transmit or execute a financial action SHALL NOT establish authority to do so.
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-AGT_INVARIANTS.md:33 | term=authority | **Normative rule:** Autonomous financial authority SHALL resolve to a valid principal or other explicitly recognized authority origin.
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-AGT_INVARIANTS.md:47 | term=authority | **Normative rule:** A delegated autonomous agent SHALL NOT possess authority broader than the authority validly delegated to it.
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-AGT_INVARIANTS.md:61 | term=authority | **Normative rule:** An autonomous agent SHALL NOT create or validate the authority required for its own consequential financial execution unless explicitly authorized by a distinct upstream mechanism.
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-AUTH_INVARIANTS.md:1 | term=authority | # FIN-AUTH — Authority Invariants
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-AUTH_INVARIANTS.md:5 | term=authority | Preserve separation between capability, possession, delegation, and current execution authority.
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-AUTH_INVARIANTS.md:17 | term=authority | ## FIN-AUTH-001 — Capability Is Not Authority
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-AUTH_INVARIANTS.md:19 | term=authority | **Normative rule:** Technical capability to execute SHALL NOT establish execution authority.
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-AUTH_INVARIANTS.md:31 | term=authority | ## FIN-AUTH-002 — Prior Authorization Is Not Current Authority
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-AUTH_INVARIANTS.md:33 | term=authority | **Normative rule:** A prior authorization SHALL NOT establish current authority without execution-time validity.
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-AUTH_INVARIANTS.md:45 | term=authority | ## FIN-AUTH-003 — Authority Cannot Self-Expand
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-AUTH_INVARIANTS.md:47 | term=authority | **Normative rule:** An actor or agent SHALL NOT enlarge its own financial authority through execution, possession, inference, or delegation.
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-AUTH_INVARIANTS.md:59 | term=authority | ## FIN-AUTH-004 — Control Is Not Authority
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-AUTH_INVARIANTS.md:61 | term=authority | **Normative rule:** Ownership control custody wallet access or key possession SHALL NOT be treated as equivalent to execution authority.
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-AUTH_INVARIANTS.md:75 | term=authority | **Normative rule:** Delegated financial authority SHALL remain bound to principal scope action time and governing constraints.
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-CMP_INVARIANTS.md:31 | term=authority | ## FIN-CMP-002 — Compensation Requirement Is Not Compensation Authority
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-CMP_INVARIANTS.md:33 | term=authority | **Normative rule:** COMPENSATION_REQUIRED SHALL NOT imply authority or admission to enter COMPENSATING.
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-DST_INVARIANTS.md:5 | term=authority | Prevent consensus or replicated agreement from becoming implicit financial authority.
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-DST_INVARIANTS.md:17 | term=authority | ## FIN-DST-001 — Consensus Is Not Authority
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-DST_INVARIANTS.md:19 | term=authority | **Normative rule:** Distributed consensus SHALL NOT by itself establish financial execution authority.
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-DST_INVARIANTS.md:45 | term=authority | ## FIN-DST-003 — Multi-Party Execution Requires Composable Authority
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-DST_INVARIANTS.md:47 | term=authority | **Normative rule:** A multi-party financial transition SHALL NOT infer whole-chain authority from the authority of any single participant.
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-DST_INVARIANTS.md:75 | term=authority | **Normative rule:** Consensus finality or replicated finality SHALL NOT erase evidence of prior authority admission or continuity failure.
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-EVD_INVARIANTS.md:45 | term=authority | ## FIN-EVD-003 — Evidence Does Not Create Authority
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-EVD_INVARIANTS.md:47 | term=authority | **Normative rule:** Evidence telemetry measurement or observation SHALL NOT create financial execution authority.
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-EXE_INVARIANTS.md:73 | term=authority | ## FIN-EXE-005 — Replay Does Not Recreate Authority
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-FIN_INVARIANTS.md:45 | term=authority | ## FIN-FIN-003 — Finality Does Not Establish Valid Authority
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-FIN_INVARIANTS.md:47 | term=authority | **Normative rule:** FINAL classification SHALL NOT prove that the originating execution possessed valid authority.
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-FIN_INVARIANTS.md:73 | term=authority | ## FIN-FIN-005 — Reopened Finality Requires Explicit Authority
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-JUR_INVARIANTS.md:5 | term=authority | Require current jurisdictional applicability and prevent authority expansion across governance boundaries.
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-JUR_INVARIANTS.md:19 | term=authority | **Normative rule:** Applicable jurisdiction SHALL be treated as execution-relevant state where it affects authority scope or admissibility.
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-JUR_INVARIANTS.md:45 | term=authority | ## FIN-JUR-003 — Cross-Boundary Authority Cannot Expand Implicitly
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-JUR_INVARIANTS.md:47 | term=authority | **Normative rule:** Crossing an institutional geographic regulatory or ledger boundary SHALL NOT implicitly expand authority.
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-REV_INVARIANTS.md:31 | term=authority | ## FIN-REV-002 — Reversal Requirement Is Not Reversal Authority
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-REV_INVARIANTS.md:33 | term=authority | **Normative rule:** REVERSAL_REQUIRED SHALL NOT imply authority or admission to enter REVERSING.
- F4-R-014 | 02-core/invariants/FIN-SET_INVARIANTS.md:61 | term=authority | **Normative rule:** SETTLED or FINALIZED settlement state SHALL NOT by itself establish valid originating authority or admission.

- F4-R-014 | 07-ledger/FIN_F4_02_CANONICAL_OBJECT_TYPE_FREEZE.md:32 | term=representation | ### F4-O-001 — Ledger-State Representation
- F4-R-014 | 07-ledger/FIN_F4_02_CANONICAL_OBJECT_TYPE_FREEZE.md:34 | term=representation | **Ledger-State Representation**
- F4-R-014 | 07-ledger/FIN_F4_02_CANONICAL_OBJECT_TYPE_FREEZE.md:36 | term=representation | A typed representation of financial state recorded or represented within a ledger or record system.
- F4-R-014 | 07-ledger/FIN_F4_02_CANONICAL_OBJECT_TYPE_FREEZE.md:38 | term=authority | It is representational rather than constitutive of authority.
- F4-R-014 | 07-ledger/FIN_F4_02_CANONICAL_OBJECT_TYPE_FREEZE.md:38 | term=representation | It is representational rather than constitutive of authority.
- F4-R-014 | 07-ledger/FIN_F4_02_CANONICAL_OBJECT_TYPE_FREEZE.md:40 | term=representation | A ledger-state representation may accurately, inaccurately, incompletely, historically, or contradictorily represent an underlying financial state.
- F4-R-014 | 07-ledger/FIN_F4_02_CANONICAL_OBJECT_TYPE_FREEZE.md:48 | term=representation | A record-state object whose representation has crossed the applicable commitment boundary of the record system.
- F4-R-014 | 07-ledger/FIN_F4_02_CANONICAL_OBJECT_TYPE_FREEZE.md:52 | term=authority | Commitment does not by itself establish financial finality, authority, irreversibility, or historical identity.

- F4-R-014 | 07-ledger/FIN_F4_02_CANONICAL_OBJECT_TYPE_FREEZE.md:60 | term=representation | A ledger or record representation asserting, recording, or preserving the finality classification of a financial state.
- F4-R-014 | 07-ledger/FIN_F4_02_CANONICAL_OBJECT_TYPE_FREEZE.md:62 | term=representation | The representation of finality is distinct from the conditions that make the underlying financial state final.
- F4-R-014 | 07-ledger/FIN_F4_02_CANONICAL_OBJECT_TYPE_FREEZE.md:70 | term=representation | A typed historical representation preserving the existence and identity of an earlier record state.
- F4-R-014 | 07-ledger/FIN_F4_02_CANONICAL_OBJECT_TYPE_FREEZE.md:90 | term=representation | A typed contradiction object identifying incompatible record-state assertions, representations, histories, or commitments.
- F4-R-014 | 07-ledger/FIN_F4_02_CANONICAL_OBJECT_TYPE_FREEZE.md:112 | term=representation | The object preserves the distinction between record representation and underlying financial finality.
